snippet.title: LIMP MODE – Official Gameplay Trailer | Drift. Tune. Survive.
snippet.description:
Wishlist LIMP MODE on Steam → https ://store.steampowered.com/app/5024540
Early Access planned for Q4 2026.

A driving survival game with real drift physics and deep tuning. Your car is your life: read fault codes with an OBD scanner, clear them to limp on, cut systems for power. The dead are out there – but they're just bad weather. The point is the car under you.

▸ Real drift physics and a tuning workshop built by an actual car diagnostics technician
▸ Working OBD tester – real fault codes, real consequences
▸ 20-player drift servers with server browser and pit lane
▸ Your cars keep their wear, damage and mileage across every mode
▸ Story Mode: 1000 km to reach your grandfather
▸ Co-op for up to 4 players

Made by a tuner – for tuners. One developer, one workshop.

Instagram: https://instagram. com/limpmode_cargame
TikTok: https://tiktok. com/@limpmode_cargame

#LIMPMODE #driftgame #indiegame #carsimulator #tuning
